title: Migrant Domestic Workers Fined for Illegal Moonlighting and Take-up Rate of Household Services Scheme
what_it_is: Migrant Domestic Workers Fined for Illegal Moonlighting and Take-up Rate of Household Services Scheme

sections.label: Migrant domestic workers moonlighting fines
sections.summary: Between 2020 and 2024, an average of 12 migrant domestic workers and 15 employers were fined yearly for moonlighting-related offences, and HSS companies grew from around 80 to 240.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Between 2020 and 2024, an average of 12 migrant domestic workers (MDWs) and 15 employers were fined each year for moonlighting-related offences.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: The Household Services Scheme (HSS) allows companies to hire migrant workers to provide part-time domestic services such as home cleaning, grocery shopping, car-washing and pet-sitting.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Manpower (Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Since formalising the HSS as a permanent scheme in 2021, the number of HSS companies increased from around 80 to 240.

sections.label: HSS and MDW costs
sections.summary: HSS is generally cheaper than hiring an MDW, with hourly rates of $18 to $30 and monthly packages, versus $1,000 to $1,300 monthly for an MDW.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
sentences.text: For households who do not need full-time caregiving needs, HSS should generally be a cheaper option than hiring a MDW.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
sentences.text: And based on MOM's poll of HSS clients, the hourly rate ranges from between $18 and $30, where the median is about $25 an hour.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
sentences.text: Most HSS companies offer deal packages, such as, $325 per month, for weekly housekeeping; and up to $580 per month for twice a week.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
sentences.text: In comparison, the monthly cost of hiring an MDW can range between $1,000 and $1,300 a month, depending on whether employers qualify for the MDW concession levies.

sections.label: Working with NTUC on awareness
sections.summary: The speaker says they are ready to work with the NTUC to further strengthen awareness of the scheme.

sentences.speaker: Mr Shawn Huang Wei Zhong
sentences.text: Most importantly, we are ready to work with the NTUC to see how we can further strengthen the awareness of this scheme.
